title: On-the-go Travel Ops Pocket Log
content:
Quick pocket log for fast trips and last-minute reimbursements (notes-to-self tone). Use as mobile reference when filing on the go.

Top-level goals:
- get pre-approval (if > $500) or quick note to manager for same-day bookings
- capture receipts with phone, tag with meeting name + date, submit within 72h
- avoid out-of-pocket > $1k unless manager signs off

Trip timeline checklist (fast lane):
- 7+ days out: create calendar event with 'Travel: <DEST> - <PURPOSE>', invite manager and local host. Book refundable flight when possible.
- 3 days out: copy itinerary into expense form, add expected per-diem estimate. Check corporate card balance or arrange petty cash.
- 24 hours: screenshot boarding pass, take photo of hotel check-in confirmation, add vendor phone numbers to contact list.
- Day-of: capture last taxi/ride receipts as they happen, mark any waived fees in notes.

Expense capture format (cut/paste into expense form):
- Date | Vendor | Category | Amount | Currency | Meeting/PO | Short note
- 2025-11-05 | Lyft | Ground-transport | 18.72 | USD | PO-20481 | Airport -> Downtown, receipt img attached
- 2025-11-05 | Hotel Indigo | Lodging | 312.00 | USD | T&E-STD | Includes wifi + tax, folio attached

Mobile receipt rules (quick):
- photo receipts: take 1 close-up + 1 contextual (show merchant logo)
- screenshots: save as PNG, filename format 'YYYYMMDD_vendor_amount' on phone
- credit card slip: if merchant name illegible, add merchant phone number in note

Per-diem quick math (for multicity):
- standard per-diem = $75/day (breakfast 15 / lunch 20 / dinner 40) unless meal is included in event
- partial day allowance = 50% of full day when travel starts/ends same day
- split-day rule: if two cities on same day, allocate meals by event local time

Vendor and emergency contacts (portable list):
- Hotel group central reservations: +1-800-555-0912 (ask for corporate rate 'Redwood Inference')
- Local AV contact (events): MediaOne AV, +1-415-555-2087 (use code REDWOOD_AV for priority)
- Ground transport desk: RoadRunner Taxis, +1-212-555-0163 (corporate account 8872)
- Preferred travel agency (bookings + refunds): Summit Travel, travel@redwood-summit.example.com

Reimbursement fast-path (72h):
- fill minimal required fields in expense form (date, vendor, amount, tag manager)
- attach receipt images (at least one). If missing: add justification and mark as 'pending receipt' with plan to upload within 5 business days
- notify manager in Slack with expense link and short reason: 'Submitted rapid reimb for taxi after red-eye — need $25 approved'
- If manager is OOO: escalate to team lead or finance@redwood.example.com with cc to travel-ops

Common gotchas / hacks:
- If payment processed on personal card and vendor provided invoice: request invoice PDF and attach — Finance prefers invoices for >$500
- For split-group tabs (team dinners): make one person the payer, attach itemized receipt and list attendees in the notes field
- For receipts > 1 page (conference folios): scan as single PDF named 'YYYYMMDD_vendor_folio'
- If receipt is solely a card statement line (no merchant receipt), attach screenshot of transaction from banking app + short memo

PO / Advance requests (quick template to paste into email to finance):
Subject: Request: Travel Advance / PO for <EVENT> <DATES>
Body (paste):
- Requestor: Aisha Rahman
- Team: Solutions Eng (if needed)
- Event: <Event name> — <venue/city> — <dates>
- Estimated total: $____ (breakdown: flights $___, lodging $___, meals $___, incidentals $___)
- Required by: <date>
- Approval: Manager <name>
- Notes: Will reconcile within 14 days after trip; receipts will be attached.

Post-trip tidy up (3–14 days):
- file full expense with all receipts, tag each item with meeting name and PO if applicable
- run quick cross-check against corporate card statement (match amounts)
- add redwood internal tags: meeting-code (e.g., RDW-ENG-2025), cost-center, and approver initials

Privacy & compliance reminders:
- never attach employee SSNs or passport scans in expense forms; store passport scans in Okta vault if needed for HR only
- if client reimburses a portion, route through finance and note payment method; do NOT accept direct client refunds to personal bank without pre-approval

Open questions / TODOs (follow-up items):
- should we add an 'urgent reimburse' Slack workflow with Finance bot? (ask @Leah)
- clarify per-diem exceptions for multi-day demo installs with client-provided meals (ask HR/policy)
- verify MediaOne AV corporate discount code (Tomás to confirm)

Quick templates (copy for Slack or email):
1) Slack to manager: "FYI submitted expense for $X (taxi/hotel). Requesting quick approval — /expenses/<id>"
2) Email to travel agency: "Booking request: <name> / dates / preferred airline / refundable? / corporate rate"

Notes to self:
- pack spare charger and ethernet dongle for on-site demo days
- set mobile card limit alert to $500/day before travel window
- keep a 1-page contact cheat-sheet in phone notes for vendor numbers

End of pocket log. Keep this doc editable — intended as scratchpad for rapid changes while traveling.

Last edited: 2025-11-06 by Aisha (quick updates to PO template and AV contact).
